external.description: Jaylen Brown’s first game against the Celtics generated plenty of conversation before tipoff. Paul George supplied the more meaningful response once they started playing. George scored 36 points in 30 minutes as the Celtics pulled away for a 123-101 win Tuesday in Philadelphia. Brown, meanwhile, struggled with foul trouble and finished with 13 points against the franchise that traded him over the summer. Not exactly the reunion the Sixers had in mind. Michael Kaskey-Blomain of Sixers On SI examined Philadelphia’s individual performances⁠, highlighting difficult nights for Brown and LeBron James, along with a useful contribution from Dean Wade.
